name: form-submit
intent: Collect and validate input with accessible error reporting.
sequence: FormField wires each control to its Label, description and message via react-hook-form context
Validation runs on blur and again on submit
FormMessage renders the error, wired through aria-describedby by FormField
On submit the primary button enters a disabled, busy state with accessible text
Success is announced by Toast; failure returns focus to the first invalid field
requiredRules: Every control has a programmatically associated Label
Errors are text, never color alone
Focus moves to the first invalid field on failed submit
forbiddenRules: No placeholder used as the only label
No validation message shown only on hover
No submit button that silently no-ops while invalid
